44. 若八位電話號碼的首三個位及尾五個位分別由 5,6,9 的排列及 2,3,4,7,8 的排列所組成，則可組成多少個不同的八位電話號碼？

A. 15
B. 126
C. 720
D. 40 320
reasoning: The eight-digit phone number is divided into two parts. The first three digits are formed by a permutation of {5, 6, 9}, which gives $3! = 6$ possibilities. The last five digits are formed by a permutation of {2, 3, 4, 7, 8}, which gives $5! = 120$ possibilities. The total number of different phone numbers is the product of the possibilities for each part: $3! \times 5! = 6 \times 120 = 720$.
